title: Payload: encounter-credential-delivery/0.1 (rltp-delivery@0.79, target Trust Tasks framework 0.4)
description: Payload schema per Trust Tasks 6.3 ($id = Type URI, describes only the payload). Post-enactment delivery of a step credential per Delivery Contract 4.3. Outer/inner consistency (document issuer = credential issuer, recipient = credential subject) is normative in Delivery Contract 4.3; credential acceptance is entirely Encounter 5.6.
